title: Program Terms, Section 1 — One Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Membership per Customer
content:
**1.1** Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus is one membership per customer. Every tier, free or paid — Pals Rewards Member, Pals Rewards Insider, Pals Rewards VIP, Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual and Tailwise Plus Premier Annual — lives on that one membership. The number of open memberships a customer may hold is 1.

**1.2** An enrollment is made only where the customer has no other membership in status active, past due or pending downgrade. This is read from the membership records held under the customer's own customer reference, not from the customer's account of it.

**1.3** A customer who asks to join again while a membership is open is handled as a tier change on that open membership.

**1.4** A closed membership may be replaced by a new enrollment. The new membership starts with a zero balance; nothing carries over from the closed one.

### How the clauses apply to the customer's existing membership

| Status of the customer's existing membership | New enrollment | What the request becomes |
|---|---|---|
| active | not made | a tier change on the open membership |
| past due | not made | a tier change on the open membership |
| pending downgrade | not made | a tier change on the open membership |
| closed | may be made | a new membership with a zero balance |
| no membership on record | may be made | a new membership |

### Example (hypothetical)

A customer whose membership was closed last year enrolls again today. The new membership opens with a points balance of zero; the points, certificates and history of the closed membership do not move across.
